pages.lesson:
LESSON: WRITING 11.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PREFIXES AND SUFFIXES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.5: Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you tell the meaning of a word using a prefix?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text
2. use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WRITING 11.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PREFIXES AND SUFFIXES
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: WRITING 11.5.1 MECHANICS OF WRITING: PREFIXES AND SUFFIXES
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text

What this means
In this part you learn to identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences

What this means
In this part you learn to use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes to a partner. (skill: use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text.
3. Practise this skill: use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you tell the meaning of a word using a prefix?
2. Which words with suffixes and prefixes are confusing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify words with prefixes and suffixes from a text.
5. Be able to: use prefixes and suffixes correctly in sentences.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
